text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's injury treatment was finally 
all wrapped up...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you worry! I'm okay, 
though. It's just a minor injury.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To the point where there'd be no problem 
if she started running right this second.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's true. It just feels a little off, but 
there's hardly any real pain at all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get back to training!
choice_data_list: If it's just to brush it off lightly...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: Overdoing it is a no-go, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? ...If you insist that much, 
maybe I will take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't like keeping you on edge either, 
you know.

After that, Fuji Kiseki stared 
frustratedly out the window...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't want to make my injury any 
worse, either.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And so, starting with some light warm-ups—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems pain surges through me 
whenever I try to move...!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a bummer, but I guess I'll give up 
for today...

To keep it from worsening any further, 
Fuji Kiseki rested quietly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks like I'm fine. There's barely 
any pain.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we'll be able to manage the 
rest of the scheduled routine after this.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to your first aid. Hehe, 
as expected of my Trainer.

Fuji Kiseki carried out her training 
without skipping a beat!
